CREATE OR ALTER procedure [utility].[AddAuditEntry] @DependentObject varchar(50), @DependentObjectID int, @ResourceID int, @Date datetime, @Action varchar(15), @MainObject varchar(50), @MainObjectID int, @NewValue varchar(50) = null, @AuditFieldTable [dbo].[AuditFieldTable] readonly as begin set nocount on; declare @DependentObjectName nvarchar(250), @MainObjectTypeName nvarchar(250), @MainObjectName nvarchar(250), @MainDescription nvarchar(max), @ConvertMainObjectTypeName nvarchar(250)
declare @tbl table (ID int identity, FieldTypeID int, FieldName nvarchar(250), NewValue nvarchar(max), MostRecentVersion int, Updated bit)
if @DependentObject is not null begin if @DependentObject = 'Fusion' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from Fusion where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'FusionType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from FusionType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'Group' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from [Group] where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'IssueType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from IssueType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'IntersectType' begin select @DependentObjectName = ITyName.Name from IntersectType O cross apply dbo.getIntersectTypeNames(O.ID) ITyName where O.ID = @DependentObjectID end
if @DependentObject = 'ReferenceItemType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from AssetType where ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' end if @DependentObject = 'Report' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from Report where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'ResponsibilityType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from ResponsibilityType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'SurveyType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from SurveyType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'Tag' begin select @DependentObjectName = Value from Tag where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'MetricAllocation' begin select @DependentObjectName = @MainObject end if @DependentObject = 'Predicate' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from [Predicate] where ID = @DependentObjectID end
else begin select @DependentObjectName = D.[Name] from ( select DisplayValue as [Name], [Object], ObjectID from AssetDetail union all select [Name], [Object], ObjectID from AssetType ) D where D.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and D.[Object] = @DependentObject end
end
if @MainObject = 'Artifact' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = A.TypeName, @MainObjectName = A.DisplayValue from AssetDetail A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject
end
if @MainObject = 'ArtifactType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Artifact Type', @MainObjectName = A.Name from AssetType A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'DisplayFormat', DisplayFormat, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject end
if @MainObject = 'Attribute' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = A.TypeName, @MainObjectName = A.DisplayValue from AssetDetail A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject end
if @MainObject = 'FieldType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Field Type', @MainObjectName = O.FriendlyName from FieldType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'FriendlyName', FriendlyName, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', [Description], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'DisplayDescription', DisplayDescription, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'FormDescription', FormDescription, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Type', [Type], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'LookupObjectType', LookupObjectType, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'LookupObjectID', LookupObjectID, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'LookupDisplayFormat', LookupDisplayFormat, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'MinimumLength', MinimumLength, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'MaximumLength', MaximumLength, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Length', [Length], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'SortOrder', [SortOrder], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IsRequired', [IsRequired], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IsListable', [IsListable], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Category', [Category], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IsDisplayable', [IsDisplayable], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IsEditable', [IsEditable], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IsPartOfKey', [IsPartOfKey], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'AllowMultipleValues', [AllowMultipleValues], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ColumnOrder', [ColumnOrder], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ColumnWidth', [ColumnWidth], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IsPrimaryFilter', [IsPrimaryFilter], 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'DefaultFormattedValue', DefaultFormattedValue, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ShowIfEmpty', ShowIfEmpty, 0, 0 from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'Fusion' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = T.Name, @MainObjectName = O.Name from Fusion O inner join FusionType T on T.ID = O.FusionTypeID where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Enabled', Enabled, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Manual', Manual, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'LockPromotedItems', LockPromotedItems, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IntervalType', IntervalType, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Interval', Interval, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ForceRefresh', ForceRefresh, 0, 0 from Fusion where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'FusionAttributeType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = T.Name, @MainObjectName = O.Name from FusionAttributeType O inner join FusionType T on T.ID = O.FusionTypeID where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from FusionAttributeType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Assignable', Assignable, 0, 0 from FusionAttributeType where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'FusionType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Fusion Type', @MainObjectName = O.Name from FusionType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from FusionType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from FusionType where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'Group' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Group', @MainObjectName = O.Name from [Group] O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from [Group] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from [Group] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'PrimaryOwnerResourceID', PrimaryOwnerResourceID, 0, 0 from [Group] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'SecondaryOwnerResourceID', SecondaryOwnerResourceID, 0, 0 from [Group] where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'Intersect' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = ITyName.Name, @MainObjectName = Iname.Name from [Intersect] O inner join [IntersectType] T on T.ID = O.IntersectTypeID cross apply dbo.getIntersectNames(O.ID) Iname cross apply dbo.getIntersectTypeNames(T.ID) ITyName where O.ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'IntersectType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Intersect Type', @MainObjectName = ITyName.Name from IntersectType O cross apply dbo.getIntersectTypeNames(O.ID) ITyName where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', ITyName.Name, 0, 0 from IntersectType O cross apply dbo.getIntersectTypeNames(O.ID) ITyName where O.ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'SubjectCardinality', SubjectCardinality, 0, 0 from IntersectType O where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ObjectCardinality', ObjectCardinality, 0, 0 from IntersectType O where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Predicate', Name, 0, 0 from predicate where id = (select predicateid from intersecttype where id = @MainObjectID) end
if @MainObject = 'IssueType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Action Type', @MainObjectName = O.Name from IssueType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from IssueType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', [Description], 0, 0 from IssueType where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'Policy' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = A.TypeName, @MainObjectName = A.DisplayValue from AssetDetail A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject;
end
if @MainObject = 'QuestionType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = T.Name, @MainObjectName = O.Name from QuestionType O inner join SurveyType T on T.ID = O.SurveyTypeID where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from QuestionType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'DisplayStyle', DisplayStyle, 0, 0 from QuestionType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from QuestionType where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'ReferenceItem' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = ATT.Name, @MainObjectName = A.Code from Asset A inner join AssetType ATT on ATT.ID = A.AssetTypeID where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = 'ReferenceItem'
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Code', Code, 0, 0 from Asset where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = 'ReferenceItem'
end
if @MainObject = 'ReferenceItemType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Reference Item Type', @MainObjectName = O.Name from AssetType O where O.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and O.[Object] = 'ReferenceItemType'
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' insert into @tbl select 0, 'DisplayFormat', DisplayFormat, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' end
if @MainObject = 'Report' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Report', @MainObjectName = O.Name from Report O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from Report where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from Report where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ObjectType', ObjectType, 0, 0 from Report where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ObjectID', ObjectID, 0, 0 from Report where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ShowOnHomePage', ShowOnHomePage, 0, 0 from Report where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'Resource' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Resource', @MainObjectName = A.FirstName + ' ' + A.LastName from reporting.Global_Resource A where A.ResourceID = @MainObjectID
end
if @MainObject = 'Tag' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Tag', @MainObjectName = T.Value from Tag T where T.Id = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Tag Name', Value, 0, 0 from Tag where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'ResponsibilityType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Responsibility Type', @MainObjectName = O.Name from ResponsibilityType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ResponsibilityTypeGroup', ResponsibilityTypeGroup, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityType where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Responsibility Type Override', @MainObjectName = RT.Name from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem O left join ResponsibilityType RT on O.ResponsibilityTypeID = RT.ID where O.ID = @MainObjectID
if not exists (select 1 from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem where ID = @MainObjectID) begin set @MainObjectTypeName = 'Responsibility Type Override' set @MainObjectName = '(Responsibility Type Removed)' end
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Responsibility Type', Name, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityType where ID = (select ResponsibilityTypeID from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem where ID = @MainObjectID) insert into @tbl select 0, 'Context', Context, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Group', g.Name, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem r inner join [Group] g on g.id = r.securityassetid where r.SecurityAsset = 'G' and r.ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'User', gr.FirstName + ' ' + gr.LastName, 0, 0 from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem r inner join reporting.[Global_Resource] gr on gr.ResourceID = r.securityassetid where r.SecurityAsset = 'R' and r.ID = @MainObjectID
end
if @MainObject = 'Rule' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = A.TypeName, @MainObjectName = A.DisplayValue from AssetDetail A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject; end
if @MainObject = 'SurveyType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Survey Type', @MainObjectName = O.Name from SurveyType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from SurveyType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Object', Object, 0, 0 from SurveyType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'ObjectID', ObjectID, 0, 0 from SurveyType where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'Taxonomy' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = A.TypeName, @MainObjectName = A.DisplayValue from AssetDetail A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject;
end
if @MainObject = 'TaxonomyType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Model Type', @MainObjectName = A.Name from AssetType A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject;
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'DisplayFormat', DisplayFormat, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'HierarchyMaximumDepth', hierarchymaximumdepth, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject end
if @MainObject = 'PolicyType' begin declare @AssetTypeID int; select @AssetTypeID = A.ID, @MainObjectTypeName = 'Policy Type', @MainObjectName = A.Name from AssetType A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject;
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'DisplayFormat', DisplayFormat, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'HierarchyMaximumDepth', hierarchymaximumdepth, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject
insert into @tbl select 0, 'IconBackColor', IconBackColor, 0, 0 from AssetTypeStyle where ID = @AssetTypeID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IconForeColor', IconForeColor, 0, 0 from AssetTypeStyle where ID = @AssetTypeID
end
if @MainObject = 'TaskType' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Task Type', @MainObjectName = A.Name from AssetType A where A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and A.[Object] = @MainObject
insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'Description', Description, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject insert into @tbl select 0, 'DisplayFormat', DisplayFormat, 0, 0 from AssetType where ObjectID = @MainObjectID and [Object] = @MainObject end
if @MainObject = 'MetricAllocation' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'MetricAllocation', @MainObjectName = AT.Name from [dbo].[AssetType] AT inner join [metrics].[Allocation] MA on MA.ID = @MainObjectID where AT.uid = MA.AssetTypeUid
insert into @tbl select 0, 'ScoreType', case when ScoreType = 1 then 'Governance' else 'Data Quality' end, 0, 0 from [metrics].[Allocation] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'AssetTypeName', AT.Name, 0, 0 from [metrics].[Allocation] MA inner join [dbo].[AssetType] AT on AT.uid = MA.AssetTypeUid where MA.ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'IsExternallyCalculated', case when IsExternallyCalculated = 0 then 'Internal' else 'External' end, 0, 0 from [metrics].[Allocation] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'LowerThreshold', LowerThreshold, 0, 0 from [metrics].[Allocation] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'UpperThreshold', UpperThreshold, 0, 0 from [metrics].[Allocation] where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'Predicate' begin select @MainObjectTypeName = 'Predicate', @MainObjectName = P.Name from [dbo].[Predicate] P where P.[ID] = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Name', Name, 0, 0 from [dbo].[Predicate] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Inverse', Inverse, 0, 0 from [dbo].[Predicate] where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl select 0, 'Functional Type', Type, 0, 0 from [dbo].[Predicate] where ID = @MainObjectID end
insert into @tbl select FieldTypeID, FieldName as FriendlyName, Value as FormattedValue, 0, 0 from @AuditFieldTable where [value] is not null
if @MainObject = 'CompanySettings' begin set @MainObjectTypeName = @MainObject set @DependentObjectName = @MainObject set @MainObjectName = @DependentObject
insert into @tbl select 1, @DependentObject, @NewValue, 0, 0
end
if @DependentObject is not null and @MainObject = 'Tag' and @MainObjectID = 0-- and @Action = 'Updated' begin insert into @tbl select 0, 'Tags', string_Agg(T.Value, ', '), 1, 1 from Asset A inner join AssetTag TA on TA.AssetID = A.ID and A.Object = @DependentObject and A.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID inner join Tag T on T.ID = TA.TagID --order by T.Value
set @MainObjectTypeName = 'Tags' set @MainObjectName = 'Tag' end
update T set T.MostRecentVersion = coalesce(S.[Version], 0), T.Updated = case when T.NewValue = S.Value then 0 when T.NewValue is null and S.Value is null then 0 else 1 end from @tbl T left join ( select V.*, F.Value from reporting.Global_Audit A inner join reporting.Global_FieldAudit F on F.AuditID = A.ID and A.[Object] = @DependentObject and A.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and A.ActionObject = @MainObject and A.ActionObjectID = @MainObjectID inner join ( select F.FieldTypeID, case when F.FieldTypeID > 0 then ' ' else F.FieldName end FieldName, max([Version]) as [Version] from reporting.Global_Audit A inner join reporting.Global_FieldAudit F on F.AuditID = A.ID and A.[Object] = @DependentObject and A.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and A.ActionObject = @MainObject and A.ActionObjectID = @MainObjectID group by F.FieldTypeID, case when F.FieldTypeID > 0 then ' ' else F.FieldName end ) V on ((V.FieldTypeID = 0 and V.FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID and V.FieldName = F.FieldNAme) or (V.FieldTypeID > 0 and V.FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID)) and V.[Version] = F.[Version] ) S on (S.FieldTypeID = 0 and S.FieldTypeID = T.FieldTypeID and S.FieldName = T.FieldName) or (S.FieldTypeID > 0 and S.FieldTypeID = T.FieldTypeID)
declare @auditID bigint, @current int = 1, @max int, @fieldTypeID int, @fieldName nvarchar(250), @version int, @value nvarchar(max), @updated bit select @max = max(ID) from @tbl
-- test if there is a previous created entry in global audit for this then it cant be a create change to update.. if @Action = 'Created' and exists(select 1 from reporting.Global_Audit where [Object] = @DependentObject and [ObjectID] = @DependentObjectID) begin set @Action = 'Updated'; end -- this is the case where the last value of a field was removed and the asset remains its not the asset being deleted just an update. else if @Action = 'Removed' and exists(select 1 from asset where [object] = @DependentObject and [ObjectID] = @DependentObjectID) begin set @Action = 'Updated'; end
if @MainObjectTypeName = 'Intersect Type' begin set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = 'Relationship Type'; end else if @MainObjectTypeName = 'Intersect' begin set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = 'Relationship'; end else if @MainObjectTypeName = 'MetricAllocation' begin set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = 'Scoring Definition'; end else begin set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = @MainObjectTypeName; end
if @Action = 'Created' begin set @MainDescription = @ConvertMainObjectTypeName + ' created' end if @Action = 'Removed' begin IF (@MainObjectTypeName = 'MetricAllocation') BEGIN declare @scoreType varchar(30); declare @assetTypeName varchar(2000); declare @isExterallyCalculated varchar(30); select @scoreType = case when ScoreType = 1 then 'Governance' else 'Data Quality' end from [metrics].[Allocation] where ID = @MainObjectID select @isExterallyCalculated = case when IsExternallyCalculated = 0 then 'Internal' else 'External' end from [metrics].[Allocation] where ID = @MainObjectID select @assetTypeName = AT.Name from [metrics].[Allocation] MA inner join [dbo].[AssetType] AT on AT.uid = MA.AssetTypeUid where MA.ID = @MainObjectID set @MainObjectName = @scoreType+ ' '+ @assetTypeName + ' {' + @isExterallyCalculated + 'ly calculated' + '}' END
set @MainDescription = @ConvertMainObjectTypeName + ' removed' end if @Action = 'Updated' begin while @current <= @max begin select @fieldTypeID = FieldTypeID, @fieldName = FieldName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current
if @updated = 1 begin set @MainDescription = coalesce(@MainDescription + ', ', '') + @fieldName + case when @version > 0 then ' updated' else ' added' end end
set @current = @current + 1 end
if @MainObjectTypeName = 'Tag' begin set @MainDescription = @MainObjectTypeName + ' updated' end end
if @MainObjectName is not null and @DependentObjectName is not null begin if coalesce(@MainDescription, @MainObject) = 'Intersect' begin set @MainDescription = 'Relationship ' + @Action end else if coalesce(@MainDescription, @MainObject) = 'IntersectType' begin set @MainDescription = 'RelationshipType ' + @Action end else begin set @MainDescription = coalesce(@MainDescription, @MainObject + ' ' + @Action) end
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin set @MainDescription = 'Tag consolidated' end if @Action = 'Update settings' begin set @MainDescription = 'Updating company settings' end
declare @updateAuditId int; if(@Action = 'Updated' and (@MainObjectTypeName = 'MetricAllocation' or @MainObjectTypeName = 'Predicate')) begin select @updateAuditId = [ID] from ( select [ID], [Date], [ObjectName], row_number() over(partition by [ObjectName] order by [Date] desc) as rn from [reporting].[Global_Audit] where [Object] = @MainObjectTypeName and [ObjectID] = @MainObjectID ) t where t.rn = 1 end
insert into [reporting].[Global_Audit] values (@DependentObject, @DependentObjectID, @DependentObjectName, coalesce(@ResourceID, 0), @Date, @Action, @MainObject, @MainObjectID, @MainObjectTypeName, @MainObjectName, @MainDescription)
select @auditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() declare @previousValue varchar(2000);
set @current = 1 while @current <= @max begin select @fieldTypeID = FieldTypeID, @fieldName = FieldName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin select @fieldTypeID = '0', @fieldName = 'Tag', @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = @DependentObjectName, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current end
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin select @fieldTypeID = '0', @fieldName = @DependentObjectName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = @NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current end
if @updated = 1 begin if(@Action = 'Updated' and (@MainObjectTypeName = 'MetricAllocation' or @MainObjectTypeName = 'Predicate')) begin select @previousValue = Value FROM [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] where [AuditID] = @updateAuditId and [FieldName] = @fieldName and [FieldTypeID] = @fieldTypeID; insert into [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] (AuditID,FieldTypeID,FieldName,Version,Value,PreviousValue) values ( @auditID, @fieldTypeID, @fieldName, @version + 1, @value , @previousValue ) end else begin insert into [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] (AuditID,FieldTypeID,FieldName,Version,Value) values ( @auditID, @fieldTypeID, @fieldName, @version + 1, @value ) end end
set @current = @current + 1 end end end
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER procedure [utility].[AddAuditEntry] @DependentObject varchar(50), @DependentObjectID int, @ResourceID int, @Date datetime, @Action varchar(15), @MainObject varchar(50), @MainObjectID int, @NewValue varchar(50) = null, @AuditFieldTable [dbo].[AuditFieldTable] readonly as begin set nocount on; declare @DependentObjectName nvarchar(250), @MainObjectTypeName nvarchar(250), @MainObjectName nvarchar(250), @MainDescription nvarchar(max), @ConvertMainObjectTypeName nvarchar(250)
declare @tbl table (ID int identity, FieldTypeID int, FieldName nvarchar(250), NewValue nvarchar(max), MostRecentVersion int, Updated bit)
if @DependentObject is not null begin if @DependentObject = 'Fusion' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from Fusion where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'FusionType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from FusionType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'Group' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from [Group] where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'IssueType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from IssueType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'IntersectType' begin select @DependentObjectName = ITyName.Name from IntersectType O cross apply dbo.getIntersectTypeNames(O.ID) ITyName where O.ID = @DependentObjectID end
if @DependentObject = 'ReferenceItemType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from AssetType where ObjectID = @DependentObjectID and [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' end if @DependentObject = 'Report' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from Report where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'ResponsibilityType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from ResponsibilityType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'SurveyType' begin select @DependentObjectName = Name from SurveyType where ID = @DependentObjectID end if @DependentObject = 'Tag' begin select @DependentObjectName = Value from Tag where ID = @DependentObjectID end

end

declare @auditID bigint, @current int = 1, @max int, @fieldTypeID int, @fieldName nvarchar(250), @version int, @value nvarchar(max), @updated bit select @max = max(ID) from @tbl
-- test if there is a previous created entry in global audit for this then it cant be a create change to update.. if @Action = 'Created' and exists(select 1 from reporting.Global_Audit where [Object] = @DependentObject and [ObjectID] = @DependentObjectID) begin set @Action = 'Updated'; end -- this is the case where the last value of a field was removed and the asset remains its not the asset being deleted just an update. else if @Action = 'Removed' and exists(select 1 from asset where [object] = @DependentObject and [ObjectID] = @DependentObjectID) begin set @Action = 'Updated'; end
if @MainObjectTypeName = 'Intersect Type' begin set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = 'Relationship Type'; end else if @MainObjectTypeName = 'Intersect' begin set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = 'Relationship'; end else begin set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = @MainObjectTypeName; end
if @Action = 'Created' begin set @MainDescription = @ConvertMainObjectTypeName + ' created' end if @Action = 'Removed' begin set @MainDescription = @ConvertMainObjectTypeName + ' removed' end if @Action = 'Updated' begin while @current <= @max begin select @fieldTypeID = FieldTypeID, @fieldName = FieldName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current
if @updated = 1 begin set @MainDescription = coalesce(@MainDescription + ', ', '') + @fieldName + case when @version > 0 then ' updated' else ' added' end end
set @current = @current + 1 end
if @MainObjectTypeName = 'Tag' begin set @MainDescription = @MainObjectTypeName + ' updated' end end
if @MainObjectName is not null and @DependentObjectName is not null begin if coalesce(@MainDescription, @MainObject) = 'Intersect' begin set @MainDescription = 'Relationship ' + @Action end else if coalesce(@MainDescription, @MainObject) = 'IntersectType' begin set @MainDescription = 'RelationshipType ' + @Action end else begin set @MainDescription = coalesce(@MainDescription, @MainObject + ' ' + @Action) end
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin set @MainDescription = 'Tag consolidated' end if @Action = 'Update settings' begin set @MainDescription = 'Updating company settings' end
insert into [reporting].[Global_Audit] values (@DependentObject, @DependentObjectID, @DependentObjectName, coalesce(@ResourceID, 0), @Date, @Action, @MainObject, @MainObjectID, @MainObjectTypeName, @MainObjectName, @MainDescription)
select @auditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
set @current = 1 while @current <= @max begin select @fieldTypeID = FieldTypeID, @fieldName = FieldName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin select @fieldTypeID = '0', @fieldName = 'Tag', @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = @DependentObjectName, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current end
if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin select @fieldTypeID = '0', @fieldName = @DependentObjectName, @version = MostRecentVersion, @value = @NewValue, @updated = Updated from @tbl where ID = @current end
if @updated = 1 begin insert into [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] values ( @auditID, @fieldTypeID, @fieldName, @version + 1, @value ) end
set @current = @current + 1 end end end
